definitions.explanation: A very large vulture of the Americas, especially the Andean condor of South America, one of the largest flying birds. It feeds mainly on carrion and soars for hours on rising air.

examples.english: A condor soars through the sky.

examples.japanese: コンドル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{翼|つばさ}→翼：03528_tsubasa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧{近|ちか}く⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: With its wings spread, a condor measures nearly three meters.

examples.japanese: アンデス⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧で、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧コンドル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{描|えが}いて→描く：02013_egaku⟧⟦{飛|と}んでいた→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧。
examples.english: In the Andes, a great condor was flying slowly in circles.

notes:
From Spanish cóndor. Known to most Japanese from the Andean folk melody 「コンドル⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{飛|と}んで→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧」 (El Cóndor Pasa).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- アンデスコンドル: Andean condor
- カリフォルニアコンドル: California condor
- コンドル⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{舞|ま}う→舞う：04573_mau⟧: a condor soars

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ハゲタカ→ハゲタカ：32274_hagetaka⟧: vulture — Old World vultures, and figuratively a predatory investor
- ⟦{鷲|わし}→鷲：04329_washi⟧: eagle — a bird of prey that hunts live animals
